meta.name: integrate
meta.description: Build or change a customer-system integration with explicit data mapping, permissions, retries and reconciliation. Use for connectors, imports, write-back and upstream APIs.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要把外部系统的数据接入或写回自己的系统。
copy.tagline_en: Connect an external system with mapping, permissions, retries and reconciliation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect a customer or partner system and keep data in sync.

howto.when: 当你要求做连接器、导入、回写等集成时接管;若由 @fde 调用,则沿用它已有的上下文和范围。

howto.what_en: Claude builds or changes a customer-system integration using the bundled method: it writes out data mapping, permissions, retries and reconciliation first, then acts. Covers connectors, imports, write-back and upstream APIs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for integration work such as connectors, imports or write-back; if invoked by @fde, it reuses that context and scope instead of restarting.
